price_signal: €65 per losse les (60 min); praktijkexamen €285; faalangstexamen €300; BNOR-examen €280
notes: Single female instructor/owner Cristel Beekwilder; one-woman rijschool. Category B only (personenauto). Specialized in faalangst (test-anxiety) learners and offers BNOR exams. No evidence of English-language instruction anywhere (official site, clickdrive, educar, rijloket, rijschoolspecialist all Dutch-only content, no English page) - distinct from other Den Bosch schools like Start Driving and Scoobz which do advertise English/automatic. No transmission type (automaat vs schakel) stated on any source, so transmission unknown. Founding: rijloket.nl states explicitly 'Sinds 2020 actief'; educar/rijschool-tips say '5 jaar' (~2021); clickdrive says '6 jaar ervaring' - minor conflict but explicit 'Sinds 2020' taken as authoritative; KvK 78624215 consistent with a ~2020 registration. CBR shows 19 first exams / 24 total last 12 months, ~84% first-time pass rate (high). Address Lokeren 138 is in the Hedel/Empel area near 's-Hertogenbosch.
